# Steam Community — guide discovery index

- Original source: [Steam Community — guide discovery index](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/guides/)
- Author / publication: Steam Community authors
- Language / date: Multiple languages; index checked 2026-09-09
- Access: Guide hub retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: [Wayback Machine, 2026-02-17](http://web.archive.org/web/20260217082202/https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/guides/)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete listing

The game's guide hub is a useful source of additional player research. The inspected listing includes secret-ending and combat guides, language/font instructions, Polish and Russian localization guides, and multiple Windows compatibility guides.

Some older performance guides are explicitly labeled outdated because the publisher changed the game. Publication date and current title therefore matter when evaluating a fix.

Steam offers generic categories such as multiplayer and co-op in the navigation. Their presence is not evidence that the game supports those features.

**Coverage:** selected substantive guides have individual entries in this collection. The hub also preserves a discovery route for newly posted or less visible material; not every community item has been inspected.
